end.summary:
Named earthworm, ant, beetle, and millipede during discussion.
Discussed that soil animals may be found under stones and in leaf litter.
Practised safe handling: put animals back and wash hands.
Earthworms and other crawling animals were still described as insects; this was not corrected by the end.
Teach-back was not passed; lesson ended at the child’s request.
end.parentNote: Asha practised naming soil animals and discussing where they may be found, using examples from stones and leaf litter. Pihu shared several animal names and the safety step of returning animals and washing hands. The mix-up between earthworms and insects remained at the end. At home, sort picture cards into “insects” and “other soil animals,” including earthworm, ant, beetle, millipede, woodlouse, and termite.
